question: Should the runtime pins be refreshed onto current `main` and accepted after benchmark-drift review, or should this generated update be replaced by a newer automation run?
rationale: Exact tool-version selection and acceptable scanner or judge output drift are release and compatibility judgments that cannot be resolved from image-build smoke checks alone.

options.title: Refresh and benchmark
options.body: Update the branch to current `main`, select current deliberate pins, and merge only after candidate-image benchmark comparisons explain any drift.

options.title: Replace this run
options.body: Close or supersede this conflicted automation run after a newer generated PR provides fresh pins and the required benchmark evidence.

recommendation.title: Refresh and benchmark
recommendation.body: Update the branch to current `main`, select current deliberate pins, and merge only after candidate-image benchmark comparisons explain any drift.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the runtime image, scanner integrations, and recent production-tool pinning decisions.
